title: eKYC verification timing out
alert: kyc-service vendor timeouts at 35%; customer vikram.t@outlook.com stuck at onboarding
root cause: The eKYC vendor lowered our rate limit and requests above it hung until timeout
failed fixes: Increasing the vendor timeout to 60 seconds
fix: Added a token-bucket queue at the new vendor limit and retried queued verifications

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=62%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during a cashback campaign used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: Money debited but payment shown failed
alert: 140 complaints: amount debited, status FAILED, no auto-reversal after 30 minutes. Example VPA meena.s@ybl
root cause: A deploy renamed the reversal queue so reversal-worker consumed from an empty queue
fix: Pointed reversal-worker at the correct queue and re-ran the missed reversal batch for the last 6 hours
